answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The umber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. The garden is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the glacier.
